title: Verifier request
description: The document a verifier reads on stdin. Exactly four fields, closed. See SPEC.md sections 3 and 5: the closed shape IS the structural invariant — there is no field in which a model handle, credential, endpoint, or conversation history could travel, so a verifier cannot consult the model that produced the candidate.

profile.description: Which question is being asked. Also the reason-code namespace (SPEC.md section 7).

task.description: What the candidate was supposed to do, in the task's own words. A verifier may ignore it; it must not be absent.

candidate.description: The artifact being judged. May be empty — an empty candidate is a legitimate subject, not an error. Always a scalar string; structured inputs that describe the candidate belong in context.

context.description: Everything else the profile needs. Profile-specific, and the only extension point. Each profile SHOULD close its own context shape; the contract only requires an object.
